info.name: Get all teams in your organization

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields you want to fetch for each team. If used, only the specified fields will be included in the response.

items.docs:
This route allows you to fetch all of the teams in your Port organization.

To learn more about teams, check out the [documentation](https://docs.port.io/sso-rbac/rbac-overview/).
